title: viola tokubuchiana var. scabrida
intro: Viola tokubuchiana var. scabrida, commonly known as the Japanese Violet, is a plant species that belongs to the violet family (Violaceae). It is a traditional medicinal herb in East Asian cultures, valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, fever reduction, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and show antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of Viola tokubuchiana var. scabrida include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
